events.evidence: The People's Bank of China cuts interest rates and lowers minimum requirements for bank reserves for the second time in two months
North Korea and South Korea agree to stop airing propaganda at the border and stand down preparations for war
A teenage girl suicide bomber kills five people and injures fourteen others in the Damaturu area in northeast Nigeria

label.note: PBOC easing and Korean de-escalation support risk; Nigeria attack and typhoon are secondary.
